comment: No source is published. The panel is headed FUSION DELAY, FLANGER, VINTAGE ENSEMBLE, and prints MOD. FREQ, OVERDRIVE, IN LEVEL, CV LEVEL, DELAY TIME, LONG over SHORT, FEEDBACK, COLOUR with a moon and a sun at its ends, DRY/WET, and the jacks INPUT, CV IN, L OUT and R OUT; no jack has a maker's name. Index order is not panel order: input 1 is INPUT and input 0 is CV IN, output 1 is L OUT and output 0 is R OUT. There is no mode control anywhere in the module, so the three names on the panel are three uses of the same delay rather than three modes, which is why the first line names only the delay. That the internal LFO is switched off by a cable in CV IN, and that the overdrive is a valve stage in the delay output and the feedback path, are from the maker's manual for the hardware. Deliberately not written: the hardware's 20ms short and 200ms long maximum delay times, and its 1024 and 4096 bucket-brigade stage counts, none of which could be checked against the plugin. The two outputs are given a line each rather than one shared line, because the hardware makes its stereo ensemble by putting a filtered out-of-phase signal on one side, and whether this build does the same could not be established.
